ideas.pitch: Real-time AI-driven mule account ring detection and visualization platform designed specifically for law enforcement financial fraud investigators.
ideas.problem_statement: Financial fraud investigation and digital forensics challenges faced by law enforcement agencies in tracking illegal money transfers.
ideas.title: MuleTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the daily pain points of cybercrime units dealing with fragmented bank transaction logs, incorporating graph intelligence and explainable AI insights that judges from Rajasthan Police can immediately appreciate for courtroom presentation.

ideas.pitch: Automated open-source intelligence gathering and entity resolution tool that aggregates digital footprints across social media and dark web dumps for cybercrime units.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT and cybersecurity investigations requiring fast correlation of disparate digital artifacts during active cyber threat assessments.
ideas.title: OSINT-Scope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an intensive manual data aggregation problem for police investigators by automating artifact linking, matching the high-utility bar set by winning tactical law enforcement tools.

ideas.pitch: Automated cryptographic tracing tool to cluster and deanonymize illicit cryptocurrency wallet transactions for law enforcement.
ideas.problem_statement: Financial fraud investigation involving cryptocurrency tracking and digital forensics for illicit asset recovery.
ideas.title: ChainForensics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the rapidly growing threat of crypto-based extortion and financial crimes in Rajasthan by providing an actionable visual link-analysis dashboard for investigators.

ideas.pitch: Zero-knowledge, biometric-authenticated evidence vault for secure chain-of-custody digital file storage and sharing between field officers and forensics labs.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital forensics and secure handling of sensitive electronic evidence without risk of tampering or leaks.
ideas.title: ZeroVault LE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages military-grade cryptography and zero-knowledge proofs tailored to legal evidentiary requirements, addressing the absolute highest priority for law enforcement data integrity.

ideas.pitch: Browser extension and backend scanning suite that detects localized phishing campaigns, fake UPI handles, and scam domains targeting Indian citizens in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity challenges involving mass digital scams and fraudulent communication channels targeting the public.
ideas.title: PhishGuard-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Protects citizens from prevalent financial scams using heuristic and ML detection tailored specifically to Indian payment systems (UPI) and regional SMS patterns, giving immediate measurable social impact.
